title: Lookahead Q-Cache: Achieving More Consistent KV Cache Eviction via Pseudo Query
selection_reason: Uses inexpensive pseudo lookahead queries to align cache-eviction importance with decoding queries, improving quality under constrained LLM KV-cache budgets.
